question.text: Pressure-volume $(p V)$ work done by an ideal gaseous system at constant volume is (where $E$ is internal energy of the system)

solution.text:
From first law of thermodynamics
$$
\Delta E=q+W
$$
where, work do net $(W)=p \Delta V$
$$
\begin{array}{l}
=p \times \Delta V \\
=0
\end{array} \quad(\because \Delta V=0)
$$
